notes: New Sounds page: Kyberpad and Audio merged into one tabbed view — Page 1/2/3 for the keypad, Effects for the RC effects, rolling and dome
Sound Min and Sound Max are now file pickers: choose a sound by its filename instead of typing a number
A range pointing at a file that is no longer on the card is flagged in red instead of failing silently
An update badge appears in the title bar when a newer firmware is published
Clear Logs actually clears, and the log view now fetches only new lines and reports the ones lost to rotation
Wording: the Kyberpad keys are called buttons everywhere in the interface
